map.低温、中温、高温釉如何区分？: How are low-fire, medium-fire and high-fire glazes distinguished?
map.通常以烧成温度划分：低温釉约 900–1050℃（铅硼熔块为主）、中温釉约 11: Usually by firing temperature: low-fire glazes about 900-1050°C (mostly lead-boron frit), medium-fire glazes about 1100-1200°C, and high-fire glazes about 1200-1300°C (feldspar porcelain glazes). The glaze formula and pyrometric cones govern.
map.过烧与欠烧有什么表现？: What does over-firing and under-firing look like?
map.过烧：釉面流淌、针孔、变形甚至粘连；欠烧：无光、橘皮、釉泡未平。二者都影响外观与: Over-firing: glaze running, pinholes, deformation and even sticking to the shelf; under-firing: dullness, orange peel and unresolved glaze bubbles. Both affect appearance and durability, and require refiring or lowering the temperature.
map.测温锥如何对应温度？: How do pyrometric cones correspond to temperature?
map.测温锥（如 Orton 锥）在特定升温曲线下弯倒对应一个温度，用于窑内实际温度判: A pyrometric cone (such as an Orton cone) bends at a temperature corresponding to a specific heating curve, and is used to read the actual temperature inside the kiln, which reflects how the body and glaze actually experience the heat better than the controller reading.
